passage:
A school built a rain garden near the parking lot. It was designed to collect rainwater and let it soak into the ground slowly.
At first, students thought it was just a flower bed. The science teacher explained that it helped reduce flooding and filter dirty water from the pavement.
During the next heavy rain, students watched water flow into the garden instead of across the sidewalk.
The rain garden made an invisible process visible. Plants, soil, and stones were working together.
The project showed that environmental design can be quiet and beautiful at the same time. A garden can be both decoration and protection.
